title: field_ops.sale.cancelled v1
description: A confirmed route sale was cancelled (ADR-37 §18.4), with its reason. Stock that had already left a truck went back to it in the same transaction (one field_ops.inventory.moved of kind sale_cancelled per line). Only a sale that had a folio is announced: a draft or a sale still waiting for an authorization never reached any consumer, so cancelling it emits nothing. A settled sale is not cancelled — a settlement is corrected with movements. Emitted once per sale AFTER the transaction that cancelled it commits; cancelling again is not announced again. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :sale, :cancelled] telemetry event that AlebrijeFieldOps.Sales fires. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_). Amounts are decimal strings with at most two decimals, never floats.

sale_id.description: The field_ops.sales row; the same sale_id its field_ops.sale.confirmed carried.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the sale (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

context_id.description: Branch (context) the sale was made in, when known.

seller_id.description: The salesperson whose folio series the sale belongs to.

folio.description: The folio the sale was confirmed with; it is not reused.

customer_crm_contact_id.description: The customer, a CRM contact with a phone (LEY DE ADMISIÓN).

modality.description: The modality the sale was confirmed with; an autosale (or a delivered presale) gave its stock back to the truck that handed it over.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount below.

total.description: The total of the sale that no longer counts (the confirmed amount it reverses).

business_date.description: The tenant-local day the sale had been confirmed in.

confirmed_at.description: When it had been confirmed (ISO-8601, UTC).

cancel_reason.description: Why it was cancelled; required to cancel.
